# AllSoft.asia

> AllSoft.asia is the self-built software collection of the software development arm of Beijing Zhuao Science And Technology Co., Ltd. Current products: ChatHub online chat (live at chathub.asia), Devil's Advocate AI decision QA service (live), TradeCN global RFQ marketplace (live at tradecn.asia) and smallfigure original asset gallery (live at smallfigure.com). All products run on Cloudflare's global edge network, accessible directly in China without VPN.

## Products

### ChatHub (Live)
Real-time online chat platform built on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects. Features: group chat, anonymous chat, random matching, online status, WeChat Pay integration. Free to start, no registration required. Independent domain: chathub.asia. Details: https://allsoft.asia/products/chathub

### Devil's Advocate / AI Decision QA (Live)
Decision quality-assurance service for AI agents: before an AI executes a major decision, an independent AI reviews it with devil's-advocate counterarguments. MCP and REST interfaces, per-call USDT(TRC20) settlement, transparent ledger. Details: https://allsoft.asia/products/devils-advocate

### TradeCN / Global RFQ Marketplace (Live)
Foreign-trade RFQ inquiry platform: buyers post sourcing requests, suppliers worldwide quote in real time. Email-verified registration, pay-per-use RFQ credits ($1 = 10 RFQs), Payoneer and other payment methods, Verified Business badge via Payoneer Checkout. Independent domain: tradecn.asia. Details: https://allsoft.asia/products/tradecn

### smallfigure / Original Asset Gallery (Live)
Gallery of original character art and game assets: hand-drawn character portraits, weapons and gear, creatures and badges, every piece with a transparent background. Filter by category, pixel size and file size, sort by size or name, search by Chinese or English name, download full-resolution PNG (512 / 1024 px) from the lightbox. Bilingual UI, no signup. Independent domain: smallfigure.com. Details: https://allsoft.asia/products/smallfigure

## Technology

- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (free tier)
- Edge computing: Cloudflare Workers
- Real-time: WebSocket + Durable Objects
- Code: GitHub
- SSL/CDN: Cloudflare (automatic)
- No servers, no VPN required, China-accessible

## Agent Access

All pages support Markdown for Agents content negotiation. Send an `Accept: text/markdown` header to receive a markdown rendering instead of HTML:

````
curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://allsoft.asia/products
````

The markdown response contains YAML frontmatter (title, description, image), the page body as markdown, and any JSON-LD structured data as a fenced json block. Responses carry `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`, `Vary: Accept` and an `x-markdown-tokens` count. Requests without the header receive HTML as usual.
